description: MEAS3: the measures that the ideas need and that the MEASURES table of the screen does not have. meas0 holds the ids of MEASURES.md. proposed holds new measures.

proposed.name: Ink floor
proposed.note: A lower bound of the ink. It gives B1 a ceiling.

proposed.name: Exact gap
proposed.note: The gap of a router to the exact answer on small boards.

proposed.name: Tracing load
proposed.note: The work of the eye to follow one route.

proposed.name: Ink hot spots
proposed.note: The peak of the ink density on a grid.

proposed.name: Monotone share
proposed.note: The share of the routes that go toward their target at each step.

proposed.name: Lane legibility
proposed.note: The lanes that a reader can tell apart at each zoom.

proposed.name: Badge overlaps
proposed.note: The count of the count badges that overlap.

proposed.name: Loops
proposed.note: The loops of a highway network and its fault tolerance.

proposed.name: Alignment
proposed.note: The count of distinct leg coordinates.

proposed.name: Highway churn
proposed.note: The highways that change between two levels. It completes Z9 and Z10.
